name: Boost My SEO with AI
author: SEO Booster

sections.description:
Boost My SEO with AI provides a best solution to analyze and improve SEO for every part of your WordPress website. Free and easy tool, anyone can use. You can set up and busy with your own business, it will post SEO friendly content time to time to improve your ranking.

Features:
– SEO analysis for entire site and individual pages
– AI-powered content rewriting based on keywords
– Keyword density checker
– Mobile responsiveness check
– Automated post time to time
– Best plugin for small and medium size business owner, who professional
– Setup to automate and it will work automatic for you

Whether you’re a blogger, business owner, or developer, Boost My SEO helps make your content more search engine friendly in a few clicks.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Boost My SEO with AI menu in the admin dashboard.
  4. For page / post SEO, you can check it individual page / post.
sections.faq:
How does the SEO checker work?

The plugin analyzes your page content for SEO best practices like title length, heading structure, keyword usage, alt text, and suggest for re-write using AI and more.

How it improve SEO rank with the help of AI?

This AI-powered SEO WordPress plugin improves your website’s rankings by automatically writing content, meta tags, and keywords in real time. It analyzes your writing for SEO best practices and rewrites content for better clarity and search visibility. The plugin also detects technical SEO issues, helping you fix them quickly. With smart automation and insights, it boosts your SEO performance while saving you time. It also do automated posts for your blog and other content pages.
